prompts.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Deliverable: ONE square transparent PNG sprite sheet containing exactly NINE sequential animation frames arranged as a strict equal 3 columns by 3 rows grid. This is a technical animation keyframe sheet, not a poster. Reference image: ONLY the TOP-LEFT neutral bust portrait is the identity reference. LISA is the SAME adult teal-bob-haired, blue-eyed woman in a navy hoodie, smooth Soft Ink outlines, flat cel shading. All 9 cells must contain an IDENTICAL head-and-shoulders portrait with pixel-registered hair, face, mouth, shoulders, garment, scale and position; ONLY eyelids move. Portrait occupies central 80% of each square cell, no cropped heads, transparent gutters. Row-major sequence 1 to 9: 1 eyes fully open warm small smile; 2 identical open; 3 eyelids halfway down; 4 eyes completely closed with gently curved lash lines; 5 identical closed; 6 halfway opening; 7 fully open; 8 identical open; 9 identical to frame 1. The closed eye frames are essential. No head/body motion, no mouth motion. Fixed camera and consistent size. Genuine RGBA transparent background, opaque character interiors, antialiased edge only. NO grid lines, labels, numbers, words, shadows, decorations, watermarks, color background. Exact 3x3 square-cell geometry. This sheet will be sliced programmatically to animate one blink.

Use case: identity-preserve. Deliverable: ONE square transparent PNG animation sprite sheet, exactly NINE frames in an exact equal 3 columns by 3 rows grid.
